verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can review their prompts, delete their Gemini Apps activity, and turn off Keep Activity in My Activity at any time. That covers both deletion and stopping retention. Related docs describe opting in or out of letting Google use audio, Live video and screenshares for model training, and a configuration where chats and uploads are not reviewed by humans or used for training. Missing for 10: documented retention periods or auto-delete schedules, granular per-chat or per-file deletion detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
